buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Ref. NCRA:123:GEM:2026-27 1) Item Description: HP make monochrome A3 multifunction laser printer, Qty.: 02 nos. 2) The item in this bid must be quoted strictly in accordance with the technical specifications given in A TC document. Any deviations will not be accepted. 3) Wherever support for any specific feature/function has been specified in the technical specifications, the quoted printer model shall have such feature/function as an integral or fully supported capability. All necessary accessories, software/drivers, licenses and other requirements required for enabling an d operating the specified features shall be included in the quoted price and supplied along with the pr inter. No additional hardware, software or license shall be required to be procured separately by NCR A-TIFR for normal operation of the specified features. 4) The bidder must be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized dealer/ distri butor of the OEM. In case of the dealer / distributor, the manufacturer authorisation certificate issued by OEM must be submitted along with bid, failing which their bid will not be considered. Non-authoriz ed dealer will also not be considered. 5) Bidders are strictly prohibited from offering any refurbished or assembled copier products for consid eration, only new and latest manufactured, OEM products will be accepted. 6) Bidders should fill and submit Technical compliance statement as given in ATC document. 7) Delivery period: within 21 days from the date of awarding of contract. 8) Payment Terms: 95% payment will be made within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of goods an d balance 5% against submission of bank guarantee / DD / FD or transfer from a nationalized / schedu led bank for warranty period +2 Months. 9) Warranty: The printer should be supplied with 3 years onsite replacement warranty and same warra nty should be visible on manufacturers website. 10) Printer to be supplied in original factory packing and it should not be assembled. 11) For any query can contact purchase@ncra.tifr.res.in Tel.: 020-25719276/9266/9206. . 3.
